label: DLP in pairing-friendly extension fields
problem: Discrete logarithms in extension fields used by pairing-friendly curves, including degree-12 families.
notes: Pairing-field structure, polynomial selection and concrete resource models matter. We retain the new pairing track as sourced reassessment events, without collapsing medium/large-characteristic regimes into one L-constant curve or asserting uniform deployment changes.

milestones.name: Extended tower NFS
milestones.event: exTNFS improves the medium-prime asymptotic complexity and applies to important degree-6 and degree-12 pairing fields.
milestones.notes: The source is a merged/revised paper. Its applicability depends on field representation and extension structure; no universal BN/BLS cost coefficient is asserted here.

milestones.name: Concrete pairing key-size reassessment
milestones.event: Reassesses popular pairing parameters after NFS advances and proposes updated key sizes.
milestones.notes: First preprint date, with revisions through February 2018. Source-specific concrete estimates require their own operation, memory and polynomial-selection conventions.
